doneRule: The gate (harness/config/quality-gates.json) is green at the recorded commit. Human checks not done are recorded as not verified. A failing gate means in_progress or blocked, not done.

retry.onExhausted: Stop. Record the failure output (failures only) in the task record, set state to blocked, report to the human.

steps: Read the diff (git status, git diff on files in scope)
Fix forward if the change is yours and the cause is clear
Otherwise ask the human; do not revert

agentMay.rule: Cut task/T-NNNN-slug from an up-to-date dev
Commit on the task branch (English message, attribution line)
Push the task branch to origin, never with force
Open a pull request from the task branch to dev
Squash-merge the pull request to dev when every land condition holds and CI is green
Delete the task branch it created, after the merge

humanOnly.rule: Open a pull request to master or merge to master
Commit or push directly to dev or master
Delete a branch the task did not create
Add, remove or change a dependency in package.json
A new ADR, or changing an accepted ADR
Any change under .claude/ (agents, skills, hooks, permissions, settings)
Weakening, skipping or allow-listing a guard test

landConditions: The gate (harness/config/quality-gates.json) is green on the task branch
The independent review result is pass and is recorded in the task record; a fix pushed after the review is verified and reviewed again
Order, step 1: stage the work, then node harness/scripts/check-claims.mjs --staged exits 0 while the claims are still active
Order, step 2: set the record to done, release the claims, move the record to harness/tasks/completed/, stage those, and node harness/scripts/validate-task.mjs exits 0
Order, step 3: one commit on the task branch carries the work, the released claims and the completed record
The pull request base is dev (gh pr view --json baseRefName) and its checks are green before the merge

approvalGates.rule: Every autonomy.humanOnly item: approved when the request or the task record names it, otherwise ask
A default in src/config/tuning/ that changes shipped behaviour: approved when the request names it, otherwise ask
Any file outside the owner's files (docs/agents/README.md): approved when the request names it, otherwise ask

approvalScope: A human-only item is approved when the human's request, or the task record's Spec under "Human decisions", names it. The approval covers that task only. Everything in autonomy.agentMay needs no approval.
